verdicts.reason: A shoves the logo into the top-right corner, off the original's centre axis. The can's base butts into the top of the dark panel, which bleeds off three edges, and the oversized headline and near-full-width CTA crowd the panel's sides with almost no margin. B keeps the centred logo → can → panel order with clean spacing and well-scaled headline and CTA type. Its only flaws are that the panel runs edge to edge instead of sitting as an inset card, and there is slightly too much empty space below the CTA.
